subject: Craddock Bridge Update and Infrastructure Funding
overview: The Council received a detailed construction update from MassDOT regarding the Craddock Bridge project and debated several significant financial transfers for infrastructure overruns and enterprise funds. Members also moved forward with municipal loan orders, discussed commuter rail schedule delays, and set a public hearing for the fiscal year 2016 tax rate.

items.title: Craddock Bridge Reconstruction Update
items.summary: MassDOT officials and project engineers provided a progress report on bridge reconstruction, addressing the schedule for the temporary bridge, phase switches, and potential bus stop relocations. The council and public expressed concerns regarding communication with local businesses and the safety of proposed temporary bus stops for seniors and people with disabilities.

items.title: West Medford Commuter Rail Schedule Update
items.summary: Representative Paul Donato reported that proposed MBTA schedule changes at the West Medford station have been postponed until April to allow for a public hearing process.

items.title: Taxi Operator License Petition
items.summary: Approved a taxi operator license for Bufon-Gaultier to drive for Citywide Taxi.

items.title: Snow and Ice Removal Deficit Transfer
items.summary: Approved the transfer of $147,687 from real estate sales to eliminate the remaining fiscal year 2015 deficit in the snow and ice removal accounts.

items.title: Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund Transfers
items.summary: Approved transfers of $212,080 and $487,920 from retained earnings to the Water and Sewer Enterprise funds, respectively, following a debate over using higher amounts from the $7.7 million surplus to prevent rate increases. Members discussed rate stability and the necessity of maintaining reserves for infrastructure repairs.

items.title: DPW Facility Project Loan Order
items.summary: Referred a $300,000 loan order for the DPW facility project to the Committee of the Whole due to significant cost overruns in soil remediation and reports of building defects including leaks and HVAC issues.

items.title: Winthrop Street Drainage Project Loan Order
items.summary: Passed the first reading of a $350,000 loan order for drainage project overruns, which city officials attribute to design errors by an outside engineering firm currently targeted for litigation.

items.title: Routine Resolutions and Community Announcements
items.summary: Passed resolutions of sympathy for Mark Spector and congratulations for Stephen South, and discussed telephone fee exemptions for seniors and safety feedback regarding the Jingle Bell 5K route.

items.title: Charter Review and Tax Rate Hearing Schedule
items.summary: Announced a public hearing for the FY16 tax rate on December 8, discussed a citizen petition for a city charter review, and requested an update on sidewalk repairs promised during the Riverside Avenue site plan review.
